faqs.question: Can this wall washer be used both indoors and outdoors?
faqs.answer: The IP66 rated version is suitable for outdoor use. For indoor applications, we also offer IP20 versions with the same optical performance. Both versions share the same mounting system for design consistency.

faqs.question: What mounting options are available?
faqs.answer: Three mounting options: track-mounted (for magnetic track integration), recessed (for ceiling integration), and surface-mounted (for direct wall/ceiling mounting). All achieve the same uniform wall washing effect.

faqs.question: هل يمكن استخدام غسالة الجدران هذه في الداخل والخارج؟
faqs.answer: النسخة المصنفة IP66 مناسبة للاستخدام الخارجي. للتطبيقات الداخلية، نقدم أيضاً نسخ IP20 بنفس الأداء البصري.

faqs.question: ما خيارات التركيب المتاحة؟
